ip_rights.summary: Official DFZ material repeatedly treats collector-owned Deadfellaz as holder/collector IP that can be folded into project products and creative programs, but the exact controlling primary holder license text and commercial/redistribution limits were not recovered in this research pass. The catalog must not invent broader rights than the available primary material proves.

evidence.note: Founder update describes collector IP and plans to fold collector IP into products/profit-share opportunities.
Collector guide describes private use of Deadfellaz as streaming identities and current collector utilities.

project_status.note: Deadfellaz remains under active DFZ Labs development. The official publication has 2025 project development and a Feb. 19, 2026 Dead Lucky update. Some prior initiatives/assets were put on ice or simplified, but the core project is not sunset.

evidence.note: Explains the active project focus and explicitly identifies certain older Metawrapz/DAO initiatives as on ice rather than the core project.
